questions.q: Who was Shaymaa to the Prophet SAW?
questions.explain: Shaymaa was Halimah's daughter who carried and played with him in Banu Sa'd.

questions.q: How old was the Prophet SAW when Halimah sent him back to Aminah?
questions.explain: Halimah feared being blamed and sent him back to Aminah when he was about four.

questions.q: Where did Aminah take him and Umm Ayman to visit Abdullah's grave?
questions.explain: Aminah took him and Umm Ayman to Yathrib, where they met the family of Banu Najjar.

questions.q: Where did Aminah die on the way back to Makkah?
questions.explain: Aminah fell ill and died at Al-Abwa' in front of him, when he was six.

questions.q: How old was the Prophet SAW when his grandfather Abdul Muttalib died?
questions.explain: When he was eight, his grandfather died and entrusted him to Abu Talib.

questions.q: Who looked after him after Aminah died?
questions.explain: Umm Ayman cared for him like a mother, and Abdul Muttalib gave him a special place on his seat.

questions.q: To whom did Abdul Muttalib entrust the Prophet SAW before he died?
questions.explain: Abu Talib was poor with many children, yet he accepted the trust of looking after him.

questions.q: The Prophet SAW spread out his cloak for Halimah, who was very old, and asked her to sit.
questions.explain: True. That was how he honoured his wet nurse.

questions.q: Halimah sent him back because she did not love him.
questions.explain: False. Halimah was afraid of being blamed if anything happened to the child in her care, because it was a trust.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Abdul Muttalib dies and he goes to Abu Talib
Aminah visits Abdullah's grave in Yathrib

questions.explain: Halimah sent him back, Aminah went to Yathrib and died at Al-Abwa', his grandfather looked after him, and then his grandfather died.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A woman who looks after a child like a mother
A resting place for caravans, where Aminah died
Village Arabs who live in tents
Children nursed by the same woman

questions.explain: Foster siblings were nursed by the same woman, Bedouins live in tents, Al-Abwa' is a caravan resting place, and a foster mother looks after a child like her own.

questions.q: Someone who did a lot for you is now old. What example does the Prophet SAW give?
options: Honour and respect them, as he did with Halimah
Wait for them to come and ask
Hand them over to someone else
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW honoured Halimah and gave special honour to Shaymaa, who had done him good.
